title: functional-equation-mirror widget params
description: A self-contained 'drag-reflect' widget for Riemann's functional equation. The reader drags a point s = sigma + i t across the complex plane; the widget draws its functional-equation partner 1 - s (the point reflection of s through the center (1/2, 0)) and computes the completed zeta xi(s) = 1/2 s(s-1) pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) zeta(s) at BOTH points, showing they are equal (xi(s) = xi(1-s)). xi is evaluated honestly for any complex s via the everywhere-convergent, manifestly s<->1-s symmetric integral xi(s) = 1/2 + 1/2 s(s-1) integral_1^infinity (theta(x)-1)/2 (x^{s/2-1} + x^{(1-s)/2-1}) dx (theta the Jacobi theta tail), evaluated by Simpson quadrature in complex arithmetic. The critical line Re(s)=1/2 is the mirror axis (inside the shaded critical strip); the first nontrivial zeros are ringed on it, and dragging s onto the line near one drives |xi(s)| to zero. Pure DOM/SVG; jsdom-safe (createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM only inside pointer handlers; the static plane is built once, only the puck + partner + readout redraw on drag, each a pair of xi evaluations).

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The reset button derives its id from this.

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing the complex-s plane, the puck, its 1-s partner, and the zero markers.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout reporting xi(s), xi(1-s), and |xi(s)|.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to drag s and watch the 1-s partner take the same xi value.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

sigma0.description: Left edge of the plane (min Re s). Default -1.5.

sigma1.description: Right edge of the plane (max Re s). Default 2.5.

t0.description: Bottom edge of the plane (min Im s). Default -15.

t1.description: Top edge of the plane (max Im s). Default 15.

sigmaInit.description: Initial Re s of the puck. Default 0.8.

tInit.description: Initial Im s of the puck. Default 6.

zeros.description: Imaginary parts (>0) of the first nontrivial zeros to mark on the critical line; each is mirrored to -t too. Default the first three: [14.134725, 21.022040, 25.010858].

resetLabel.description: Label for the reset button. Defaults to '↺ Reset'.
